name: beech
description: A calm beach sand-and-waves toy for web and mobile, built with Babylon.js.

scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.server:dev: npm run build:accounts && cd server && npm run build && DEV_AUTH=1 PORT=8787 ADMIN_DEV_PORT=8788 BEECH_APP_URL=http://localhost:8787 GAME_URL=http://localhost:8787 ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,capacitor://localhost,https://localhost node build/server.js
scripts.build:steam: VITE_ACCOUNTS=1 VITE_PLATFORM=steam VITE_API_URL=https://play.beech.games tsc --noEmit && VITE_ACCOUNTS=1 VITE_PLATFORM=steam VITE_API_URL=https://play.beech.games vite build
